parameters.content:
# Governance Verdict
- Verdict rule: this manifest summarizes governed completion only when the mapped runtime-owned evidence families below already exist on the official runnable route; it does not create replacement route-proof evidence inside this terminal step.
- Current status: completed on the terminal official runnable route that emitted this manifest.
- Current node: state.done
- Final Done reached: yes on the route that emitted this manifest.
- Missing evidence rule: any null or missing mapped evidence family below must be reported as missing evidence and blocks a compliant interpretation outside this manifest.
- Next action: use commit_report_ready and this runtime-owned completion manifest for final handoff.

# Evidence Checklist
- workflow_runtime_copy_json: runtime-owned workflow copy for the official run chain.
- event_log_file: runtime-owned event log for the same chain.
- review_fix_loop_evidence: prerequisite review and fix lineage for this slice.
- commit_report_ready: completion-time handoff readiness evidence.
- checked_in_skill_markdown_asset: SKILL.md remains the authoritative checked-in source deliverable.
- checked_in_package_lock_asset: assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json remains the authoritative checked-in runtime lock.
- node_to_file_map: assets/so-workflow/node-to-file-map.md remains the authoritative node-to-artifact map.
- internal_document_evidence: target-local document snapshots and manifest provenance were inspected under the declared target skill root.
- completion_manifest_reference: this runtime-owned manifest reference anchors the final verdict surface.
- completion_manifest_md: this human-reviewable manifest is the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist surface.

This manifest summarizes governed completion from the existing runtime-owned evidence families. It does not replace those evidence families, it does not claim to recreate checked-in source deliverables, and it does not self-certify route-proof evidence that was absent before the terminal step.
